html:
SMTO-MEM-0012 — Choose one place for this file in Knowledge

GUID: 39b1ff99-8018-56e8-9b5c-2723a5adc53c
Slug: knowledge-choose-one-destination
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • Knowledge needs exactly one place for a new file: one collection or one conversation. This upload named neither, or both, so the file wasn't added.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Knowledge. On the Documents tab, either choose a conversation under This conversation and select Show conversation sources, or select one collection under Private collections. The page sends your file to the single place you selected.
  2. Check that the heading above the document list shows the collection's name or Conversation sources, then select Upload documents and choose the file. The heading confirms that exactly one place is selected before the upload starts.
  3. To use the same file in several conversations, put it in a collection, then use Attach selected collection for each conversation. A file belongs to one place, but one collection can be attached to many conversations.

What success looks like

  • The file appears in the document list as Waiting to index and later shows Ready to search.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, saying which collection or conversation you chose. Don't delete other sources or conversations to try to fix this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagService.import_bytes rejected the upload because exactly one of conversation_id or collection_id must be supplied, and the request supplied neither or both.

What this means

  • The source needs one place to belong: either a reusable collection or a particular conversation. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported choose_one_destination. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The upload names one destination.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Send the upload (POST /api/agent/rag/documents/upload or /documents/note) with exactly one of conversation_id or collection_id. The rejected request stored nothing, so correcting the destination and uploading again is safe.
  • Select either a collection or a conversation before adding the source.

Retry and execution caution

  • The upload names one destination.

How to verify the fix

  • The upload names one destination.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
